scripts.test: ng test print-server --watch=false && npm run test:api
scripts.test:api: vitest run shared/src/ packages/agent/src/ packages/server/src/app/helpers/ packages/server/src/app/components/manage-printer/helpers/ packages/server/src/*.test.ts packages/server/src/api/ packages/server/src/app/auth/msal.config.spec.ts
scripts.typecheck:api: tsc -b shared && tsc -p packages/server/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/agent --noEmit && npm run typecheck:api:tests
scripts.typecheck:api:tests: tsc -b shared && tsc -p shared/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/server/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/agent/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:agent
scripts.compose:check: for f in examples/compose.*.yml; do UPLOAD_TOKEN_SECRET=x PRINT_SERVER_URL=x PRINT_AGENT_TOKEN_IPP=x PRINT_AGENT_TOKEN_CUPS=x docker compose -f "$f" config -q || exit 1; done && docker compose -f compose.yml config -q
